packs.name: Sessions Drum Collection
packs.description: Six recorded acoustic drum libraries: Big Rusty Drums, Swirly Drums, Frankensnare, DRSKit, Naked Drums and MuldjordKit. 6,061 recordings, about 1.2 GB extracted. Separate from the built-in kits. CC0 and CC BY 4.0; credits and licenses included.
